file_contents.AGENTS.md:
# Repository instructions

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` before pushing. CI runs the same
command on every push and pull request.
Keep schema changes and adapter changes in separate commits when practical.
Prefix commit subjects with a type, e.g. `feat: settlement amount units`.
file_contents.CLAUDE.md:
# CLAUDE.md

This repository's contributor instructions live in `AGENTS.md` and
`CONTRIBUTING.md` — follow them.

Quick reference:
- Test: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`
- Design decisions live in `docs/decisions/` (template: `docs/decisions/TEMPLATE.md`).
  If a change alters what a note describes, update the note in the same PR.
file_contents.CONTRIBUTING.md:
# Contributing

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` before pushing. CI runs the same
command on every push and pull request.

If a change alters something a design note describes, update the note in the
same pull request. Reviewers ask for this. Start new notes from
`docs/decisions/TEMPLATE.md`.

Pull requests use the checklist in `.github/pull_request_template.md`.
file_contents.docs/decisions/TEMPLATE.md:
# [Short title of the decision]

[Month year], agreed in [where this was agreed].

[What problem forced a decision. Be concrete about the symptom, not just the
abstract tradeoff.]

[Alternatives considered and why each was rejected. Then the chosen approach
and why it won.]

[Any rule the reader needs to apply the decision correctly — rounding,
ordering, edge cases.]

[The condition under which this note stops describing what the code should
do. Every note should have one.]
